title: Descarga torn signal
story: Descarga De La Luz at 112 bpm: a quiet salsa intro (rms 0.06) opens with one huge hit at 14 (29.2), the first tear. The build from 74 tears on every strong hit with a little more each time while the brightness and hue rise under it. The drop at 279 flashes, the biggest hit at 292 (16.6) tears hardest and the hue swings -0.1 as the contrast opens; the groove after it tears on the bright strokes, zooms on the open tones and shakes on the bass, the hue sways every two beats, and the crown fires on 902 (10.4).
